bio_p1: Dr. Janny Myburg (MBChB, Diploma in Mental Health) is a medical doctor with a passion for making complex health information genuinely accessible.
bio_p2: After years of clinical practice, she recognised a pattern: patients were leaving consultations with results they didn't understand and no practical guidance on what to do next. Glucose health was a recurring blind spot — one with enormous consequences for energy, weight, mental clarity, and long-term disease risk.

faq.question: Do I need a CGM (continuous glucose monitor) to participate?
faq.answer: No — a CGM is optional. The course and group programme are valuable without one. However, wearing a CGM for even 2 weeks can make your learning much more personal and impactful, because you see your own body's responses in real time.

faq.question: Is this suitable for someone who has already been diagnosed with diabetes?
faq.answer: The programme is primarily designed for people with insulin resistance, prediabetes, or those wanting to optimise their metabolic health. If you have Type 2 diabetes and are on medication, please consult your doctor before joining — Dr. Janny can also discuss this with you in a personal consultation.

faq.question: How is an online consultation with Dr. Janny structured?
faq.answer: A one-on-one video consultation typically runs 45–60 minutes. Dr. Janny will review your blood results, discuss your symptoms and goals, and provide a personalised action plan. You can also share CGM data if you have it.

faq.question: What if I miss a live webinar session in the group programme?
faq.answer: All live webinar sessions are recorded and shared with group participants, so you won't miss anything if you can't attend live.

faq.question: How do I purchase a CGM in South Africa?
faq.answer: Dr. Janny can guide you on where to purchase a CGM and which sensor is recommended. Common options available in South Africa include the Libre system. This can be discussed in your consultation or at the start of the group programme.
